config.selectionRule: A* preferred action first; if needed sweep all immediately safe frontier actions; real score gains commit; bounded no-score bridges are tentative

interpretation: The full measured MaleCNS and V5 sensory/core policy remain frozen and active. Only the existing small motor readout output layers are minimally repaired. Terminal failures and long no-progress tails are both treated as repair frontiers. At each frontier the A* first action is preferred, but if that action is incompatible with the current closed-loop readout the script also evaluates every other immediately safe local action. For stalls, the earliest teacher disagreement in the current no-progress tail is repaired so the repeated blocked/waiting suffix is not protected. The update direction is projected into the exact nullspace of every earlier on-policy readout feature. Score-neutral teacher-approved moves may be used only as a bounded tentative tactical bridge; the bridge commits only after real score gain. Final success additionally requires a bounded no-progress streak and blocked-action rate.
